name: experiment_hub
description: Open the Experiment Hub — a persistent, multi-tab dashboard subtab that turns selected research proposals into runnable training experiments: Selection -> Implementation -> Review & Combo -> Experiments. Opened via the proposal-selection handoff (its 'Go To Experiment Hub' button) or the /experiment-hub slash; not LLM-invoked.

parameters.name: proposals_path
parameters.description: research-propose outputs dir (or its proposals.json) used to seed the Selection tab.

parameters.name: selected_proposal_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated proposal IDs to pre-select in the hub.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: How to group selected proposals for implementation (e.g. 'batch').

parameters.name: auto_implement
parameters.description: If set, immediately enqueue implementation of the selected proposals (the hub is otherwise the single implementation owner).

usage_guidance: Opened by `proposal-selection --experiment-hub` (the widget's submit button becomes 'Go To Experiment Hub') or by the user via `/experiment-hub <proposals_path>`. Single active hub per session (singleton); resumable from session_store.
